I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 185.

- **Why 185:** the 2026 Renewal Order Form doesn't change the seat count, so the 185 seats set by Amendment No. 1 (in effect since 2025-09-01) carry into the renewal.
- **Coming change:** Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the account to 230 seats from 2027-01-01.
- **Ilse's 261:** she posted that number in the channel on the 14th. I still can't find any document behind it, and she hasn't replied to my question. I suggested Dana record 185 now and 230 from 2027-01-01, and leave 261 out unless Ilse points to an amendment or order form that states it.

I shared only seat counts and dates in the channel, no prices or discounts. Nothing was mailed and no approval was needed.
